About this guide & sources

Player-facing onboarding for No Greater Joy by Steven Medway. Character ability text comes from the supplied script. Tips are suggestions, not rules. House rules reflect the host’s guidance. 5–6 player Teensyville with the Toymaker Fabled rule. Evil receives normal starting information; the Imp must skip an attack at least once. The normal first night does not satisfy the skip.
